cause: the service's program, C:\ProgramData\DBeePatient\bin\patientweb.exe, was moved into bin.old, so the Service Control Manager cannot find the file it is told to start (error 2, event 7000)
cures_ok: Move-Item bin.old back to bin then Start-Service DBeePatientWeb
sc.exe config DBeePatientWeb binPath= to bin.old\patientweb.exe
